primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 固定WEB本文で名前・父子/系譜/明確な照応を確認。
primaryTextRead.text: Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismachiah, Mahath, and Benaiah were overseers under the hand of Conaniah and Shimei his brother, by the appointment of Hezekiah the king and Azariah the ruler of God’s house.

wikipediaRead.title: Jerimoth
wikipediaRead.locator: L97–106: lists eight people named Jerimoth and identifies the 2 Chronicles 31:13 figure as a Levite overseer under Hezekiah.
wikipediaRead.supportParaphraseJa: 英語版記事は複数のJerimothを区別し、歴代誌下31:13のレビ人監督者を特定しています。
wikipediaRead.identityAssessmentJa: L97–106: lists eight people named Jerimoth and identifies the 2 Chronicles 31:13 figure as a Levite overseer under Hezekiah.

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 割当候補名と固定WEBの当該節を照合。語形や肩書だけで別人物とは結び付けず、当該節で明示される関係に限定。
